Create a production sprite atlas for a mobile gym exercise app. Use the reference ONLY for the consistent athlete identity and crisp detailed pixel-art illustration style: young adult man with short brown hair, yellow athletic tank top, charcoal shorts, white socks and trainers, realistic athletic anatomy. Exactly TWO COLUMNS and FOUR EQUAL ROWS on a portrait canvas, each cell occupying exactly one eighth of the canvas. Every row is a different exercise; left column starting pose, right column ending pose of the SAME rep. Equal scale and consistent side/camera within each pair. Leave generous transparent padding inside each cell so equipment and limbs never touch another cell. Render entire athlete and all equipment inside each cell. Genuinely TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no floor or background, no shadows, no glow, no captions, no letters, no grid lines, no labels. Precise anatomical grips, one hand per side of any bar, correct apparatus for each exercise. ROW 1: Dumbbell goblet squat, FRONT THREE QUARTER VIEW. LEFT standing with one dumbbell held vertically at chest with both hands; RIGHT deep comfortable squat with dumbbell at chest, heels grounded and knees tracking toes.
ROW 2: Incline barbell bench press, SIDE THREE QUARTER VIEW. Bench tilted 30 degrees. LEFT bar lowered to upper chest with elbows bent, one hand on each side of torso gripping bar; RIGHT bar raised above shoulders with both arms extended, both hands correctly separated. Same bench and bar in both poses.
ROW 3: One-arm dumbbell row supported on flat bench. LEFT left knee and left hand on bench, right foot on floor and right arm hanging straight holding dumbbell; RIGHT identical body support, right elbow pulled behind torso and dumbbell near hip. No extra limbs.
ROW 4: Barbell front squat, side three-quarter view. Bar resting on FRONT shoulders in front-rack, elbows forward high. LEFT upright standing; RIGHT squat with bar still on FRONT shoulders, heels planted. NOT back squat.
